install: if ! command -v bwrap >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n apt-get --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then (sudo -n DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo -n DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq bubblewrap) || true; fi && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
